reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE (brand = 'Joyforge' OR brand = 'Hivo') AND unit_cost_eur < 50
alternatives:
SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost_eur < 50 AND (brand = 'Hivo' OR brand = 'Joyforge')

SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE (brand = 'Joyforge' AND unit_cost_eur < 50) OR (brand = 'Hivo' AND unit_cost_eur < 50)

SELECT product_id, product_name, brand, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE (brand = 'Joyforge' OR brand = 'Hivo') AND NOT unit_cost_eur >= 50
